caseName: Enterprise Railway Equipment Co. v. Norfolk & Western Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Enterprise Railway Equipment Company v. Norfolk & Western Railway Company
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. H. N. Low and Mr. George I. Haight for appellant., Mr. Theodore W. Reath and Mr. Robert J. Fisher for appellee.

opinions.text:
